summary: [Google Analytics 4] events: NO native webhooks or push for GA4 Data API: change detection is poll-only (scheduled runReport/batchRunReports windows; runRealtimeReport for last 30 min, a subset of processed data). Data latency: most data within 24h; full processing (attribution, session stitching, conversions) up to 48h: query dates at least 48h in the past for stable numbers.
